facebook.content:
“Then He said to them, ‘The kingdom of God is not coming with signs to be observed—​it is in your midst.’” — Luke 17:21  

The Kingdom is not a future event; it is the authority you exercise now when you submit to Christ’s lordship. Every decision, every word, either expands His reign or surrenders it.  

What area of your life will you claim for the Kingdom today?

instagram.content:
“His kingdom is not a matter of talk … but of power.” — 1 Cor 4:20  

The Kingdom moves today when we wield the authority Christ gave us, not when we merely discuss it. Every decision you make can either release His power or keep it dormant.  

What authority are you exercising right now?
